Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: standalone illustration asset for an interactive bus-maintenance web application.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat pale blue-grey #eaf0f4 background.
Style/medium: premium vector-like technical illustration with clear crisp dark ink outlines, precise mechanical shapes, and soft restrained cel shading. Off-white and light grey metal, dark charcoal details, deep-green painted accents. Smooth clean illustration, neither photorealistic nor a plasticky 3D render.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2 canvas, about 1536x1024 pixels. Single complete isolated object centered, approximately 10% clear padding around every extent. All essential forms legible when displayed at 700 pixels wide.
Constraints: generic conceptual coach components; no identifiable manufacturer or model. No text, numbers, letters, arrows, labels, UI, logos, watermark, warning badges, fault symbols, or glowing overlays. No people, workshop, backdrop objects, decorative elements, or extra panels. This is artwork to be overlaid with interactive code hotspots later.
Primary request: a complete white-and-deep-green single-deck rear-engine coach, facing RIGHT, illustrated in a clean mostly side view with subtle three-quarter perspective that reveals its roof. The front windshield and nose are at RIGHT; the rear is at LEFT. Show the entire coach with no cropping. White upper body with deep green lower body, dark passenger windows. A large lower rear service panel at LEFT is open/cut away to reveal the diesel engine assembly inside. The central rooftop AC unit is clearly visible. Near the RIGHT front wheel, a modest cutaway exposes the disc-brake assembly while retaining a readable vehicle wheel silhouette. Keep the overview a clear coherent bus, with engine, rooftop HVAC, and front brake positioned in their respective real-world regions.
